stories.title: Tensioni per la convocazione dei gruppi di estrema destra in Puerta del Sol, 3 arresti

en.title: Tensions over far-right group gathering at Puerta del Sol, 3 arrests
en.summary: Police deployed extensively at Puerta del Sol to prevent clashes between far-right groups and housing rights activists, resulting in three arrests.

stories.title: Marcello Fois, con "L'immensa distrazione", vince la 64ma edizione del Campiello

en.title: Marcello Fois wins the 64th Campiello Prize with "L'immensa distrazione"
en.summary: Marcello Fois' novel received 83 votes from the Jury of Three Hundred Anonymous Readers to win the Campiello Prize, with the ceremony held for the first time at the Lido Film Palace in Venice.

stories.title: Marcello Fois vince il Campiello e lo dedica a Murgia: “Era bellissima”

en.title: Marcello Fois wins the Campiello and dedicates it to Murgia: "She was beautiful"
en.summary: Marcello Fois won the 64th Campiello Prize, with the ceremony held for the first time at the Lido Film Palace, dedicating his victory while another author finished second by just three votes.

stories.title: Intesa alza l'Opas su Mps: più cash, ma salta tutto se i soci approvano il piano Lovaglio

en.title: Intesa raises its offer for Mps: more cash, but falls through if shareholders approve Lovaglio's plan
en.summary: Intesa increased its takeover bid for Mps to 31.4 billion euros, though the deal collapses if shareholders approve an alternative plan, with guarantees for employment and Siena's leadership role in central-southern Italy.

stories.title: Marcello Fois, ringrazio Michela Murgia, una donna bellissima e resiliente (2) per awn

en.title: Marcello Fois, I thank Michela Murgia, a beautiful and resilient woman (2) for awn
en.summary: Marcello Fois, winner of the 2026 Campiello Prize, expressed gratitude toward Michela Murgia and acknowledged the literary world.

stories.title: Mosca: stranieri e diplomatici lascino Kiev. Zelensky: aumenteremo i raid sulle raffinerie

en.title: Moscow: foreigners and diplomats leave Kyiv. Zelensky: we will increase raids on refineries
en.summary: Russia called for foreigners and diplomats to leave Kyiv as Ukraine reported attacks on infrastructure including a northern bridge, with casualties. Ukraine's president vowed to intensify operations against Russian refineries while Moscow announced a significant military spending increase.

stories.title: Garlasco, i legali di Alberto Stasi: "Non solo il Dna, altri elementi faranno scalpore"

en.title: Garlasco, Alberto Stasi's lawyers: "Not just DNA, other elements will cause a stir"
en.summary: The legal team representing Alberto Stasi in his conviction review case for Chiara's murder indicated that additional evidence beyond DNA testing will emerge during proceedings.

stories.title: Marcello Fois vince per un soffio il Premio Campiello 2026

en.title: Marcello Fois narrowly wins the 2026 Campiello Prize
en.summary: Marcello Fois won the 2026 Campiello Prize with his work L'immensa distrazione, securing the award by a narrow margin of 83 votes.

stories.title: Premio Campiello, vince Marcello Fois: “Lo dedico a Michela Murgia: era bellissima”

en.title: Campiello Prize, Marcello Fois wins: "I dedicate it to Michela Murgia: she was beautiful"
en.summary: Marcello Fois won the Campiello Prize with his work "L'immensa distrazione," narrowly beating another novel by just three votes from a jury of three hundred readers. The winner dedicated his victory to deceased writer Michela Murgia.

stories.title: Intesa aumenta di 0,25 euro il corrispettivo cash dell'Opas su Mps

en.title: Intesa increases cash consideration of Mps takeover bid by 0.25 euros
en.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has raised its cash offer for the Mps takeover by 0.25 euros per share, bringing the total monetary value to 31.4 billion euros if the bid proceeds.

stories.title: Spagna in piazza per la casa, 70 mila con le chiavi in mano. Blitz dell'estrema destra: tre arresti

en.title: Spain in streets over housing, 70,000 with keys in hand. Far-right blitz: three arrests
en.summary: Spain saw large-scale housing protests across dozens of cities following an elderly woman's eviction and government decree rejections. Three far-right activists were arrested during the demonstrations, which highlighted the rental crisis affecting the country.

stories.title: Via da Roma il cardinale Gambetti: perché Leone manda in Abruzzo il potente arciprete di San Pietro

en.title: Cardinal Gambetti leaves Rome: why Pope sends influential St. Peter's archpriest to Abruzzo
en.summary: Cardinal Gambetti, a Franciscan who increased basilica revenues but faced some concerns, has departed Rome from his key Curia position, which is now vacant.

stories.title: L’ex fabbrica di rame diventa luogo di cura per più di 100 patologie

en.title: The former copper factory becomes a care facility for more than 100 diseases
en.summary: Dynamo Camp, established in 2007 as a summer facility providing free stays for children with cancer, has evolved over two decades into a treatment center addressing numerous conditions.

stories.title: Posti barca, in Italia sono 172mila ma solo il 2% è dedicato ai superyacht

en.title: Boat berths, Italy has 172,000 but only 2% are dedicated to superyachts
en.summary: Italy has 172,000 boat berths, with only 2% designated for vessels over 24 meters. Liguria and Toscana regions account for approximately half of the superyacht capacity.

stories.title: Sardegna, pastori pronti alla mobilitazione per prezzo del latte e rincari

en.title: Sardinia, shepherds ready for mobilization over milk prices and increases
en.summary: Six hundred representatives from the dairy sector met to discuss conditions they describe as worse than in 2019, signaling preparation for organized action regarding milk pricing and cost increases.

stories.title: Bilancio UE: 17 paesi contro nuovi tagli a Coesione e Agricoltura

en.title: EU Budget: 17 countries oppose new cuts to Cohesion and Agriculture
en.summary: Seventeen EU member states have sent a letter to European leadership ahead of an October 15-16 council meeting to express opposition to proposed reductions in cohesion and agricultural funding within the 2024-2034 budget framework.

stories.title: Puglia, debutta l’aero cargo Taranto Grottaglie per l’agroalimentare del Sud

en.title: Puglia launches cargo air service from Taranto Grottaglie for Southern agricultural products
en.summary: A new cargo airline service has begun operating in Puglia in collaboration with Turkish Airlines, transporting agricultural goods through Istanbul for distribution worldwide.
